```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(limma)
library(here)
library(janitor)
library(Biobase)
library(patchwork)

# Ensure required scripts are loaded
source(here("scripts_notebooks", "required.R"))
```

# Preprocessing - S.aureus Infection Subsampling

## 1. Load and Pre-Filter ExpressionSet Data
```{r}
eset_human <- readRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_eset.rds"))

# Baseline expression intensity filtering threshold
genes_to_keep <- exprs(eset_human) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ . > 6)) %>% 
  rowSums() %>% 
  { . >= 5 }

eset_filtered <- eset_human[genes_to_keep, ]
meta_df <- as_tibble(pData(eset_filtered), rownames = "sample_id")
expr_matrix <- exprs(eset_filtered)
unique_participants <- meta_df %>% pull(participant_id) %>% unique()
```

## 2. Defensive Subsampling Function
```{r}
draw_flexible_subset <- function(participants_list, metadata, target_n = 5) {
  valid_draw <- FALSE
  attempts <- 0
  
  while(!valid_draw) {
    attempts <- attempts + 1
    if(attempts > 500) stop("Could not find a balanced subset.")
    
    # Randomly sample N individuals
    selected_ids <- sample(participants_list, size = target_n, replace = FALSE)
    
    sub_meta <- metadata %>% 
      filter(participant_id %in% selected_ids)
    
    # Ensure both pathogen classes are present if possible, or just proceed if only one
    has_diversity <- (length(unique(sub_meta$pathogen)) > 1)
    
    if(has_diversity) {
      valid_draw <- TRUE
    }
  }
  return(sub_meta)
}
```

## 3. Run Multi-Iteration Simulation Loop
```{r}
n_iterations <- 20 
cohort_n <- 10      

set.seed(123) 

df_global_runs <- tibble(iteration = 1:n_iterations) %>%
  mutate(
    sampled_metadata = map(iteration, ~ draw_flexible_subset(unique_participants, meta_df, target_n = cohort_n)),
    
    limma_results = map(sampled_metadata, ~ {
      sub_meta <- .x
      sub_expr <- expr_matrix[, sub_meta$sample_id]
      
      # Design matrix WITHOUT sex, age, ethnicity. Including batch_experimental
      design_sub <- model.matrix(~ pathogen + batch_experimental + 0, data = sub_meta)
      colnames(design_sub) <- make.names(colnames(design_sub))
      
      # Fit Limma model
      fit_sub <- lmFit(sub_expr, design = design_sub) 
      
      # Adjust contrasts for pathogen
      # This needs to be checked based on actual pathogen levels
      # Assuming condition levels based on meta_df structure
      cont.matrix <- makeContrasts(pathogenStaphylococcus.aureus - pathogenControl, # Adjust as needed
                                   levels = design_sub)
      
      fit2_sub <- contrasts.fit(fit_sub, cont.matrix)
      fit2_sub <- eBayes(fit2_sub, robust = TRUE, trend = TRUE)
      
      res_list <- lapply(1:ncol(fit2_sub), function(i) {
        df_res <- topTreat(fit2_sub, coef = i, adjust = "fdr", p.value = 1, number = Inf, confint = TRUE)
        df_res$symbol <- rownames(df_res)
        df_res$comparison <- colnames(fit2_sub)[i]
        rownames(df_res) <- NULL
        return(df_res)
      })
      
      do.call(rbind, res_list)
    })
  )
```

## 4. Data Processing & Summary
```{r}
saureus_human_subsampled_degs <- df_global_runs %>%
  select(iteration, limma_results) %>%
  unnest(limma_results) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  group_by(comparison, symbol) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = median(p_value),
    adj_p_val = median(adj_p_val),
    mean = median(log_fc),
    lower = median(ci_l),
    upper = median(ci_r),
    ave_expr = median(ave_expr),
    pct_iterations_significant = mean(adj_p_val <= 0.05) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(organism = "Human")

# Save
saureus_human_subsampled_degs %>% saveRDS(file = here("tables", "saureus_infection_human_dge_subsampled_degs.rds"))

# Summary report
saureus_human_subsampled_degs %>% 
  filter(adj_p_val <= 0.05) %>% 
  summarise(n_robust_degs = n()) %>% 
  print()
```

## 5. Demographics Analysis
```{r}
demographics_summary <- df_global_runs %>%
  select(iteration, sampled_metadata) %>%
  unnest(sampled_metadata) %>%
  select(iteration, participant_id, age, sex, race) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(iteration) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age   = mean(as.numeric(age), na.rm = TRUE), 
    prop_male  = mean(sex == "male", na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_white = mean(race == "white", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(iteration = factor(iteration, levels = 1:max(iteration)))

# Plots
plot_age <- ggplot(demographics_summary, aes(x = "Mean Age", y = iteration, fill = mean_age)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", name = "Mean Age\n(Years)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  labs(y = "Subsampling Iterations (n=10)")

print(plot_age)
```
